profileText: a Representative and a Senator from North Carolina; born in Davie County, N.C., October 21, 1971; graduated from Davie County High School, Mocksville, N.C., 1990; B.S., Appalachian State University, Boone, N.C., 1994; M.A., Dallas Theological Seminary, Dallas, Tex., 1998; M.B.A., Wake Forest University, Winston-Salem, N.C., 2007; business owner; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Fifteenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2017-January 3, 2023); was not a candidate for reelection to the House of Representatives but was elected as a Republican to the United States Senate in 2022 for the term ending January 3, 2029.
